resources.string: Choose the touch movement controls used by this MIDlet. D-pad and analog stick share the same guest input ownership path.
The D-pad is available as one grouped virtual movement control.
Show a grouped 8-way D-pad. Move and resize the whole D-pad in the virtual-controls layout editor.
Show a grouped analog stick. It uses the shared deadzone/direction processor and can be moved or resized as one control.

Drag controls to move them. For buttons, move two fingers horizontally or vertically to change width or height, or diagonally to change both. D-pad and analog stick resize proportionally. Tap Finish Editing when you are done.
Virtual controls edit mode: drag to move, pinch to resize.

Use the D-pad or left stick to navigate JL-Mod Plus, A to activate, and B to go back. During MIDlet runtime, physical keyboard/keypad/gamepad buttons use the same Key Mappings. Map any physical button to M if you want it to open the runtime MIDlet menu. Analog sticks, triggers, pointer input, calibration, and virtual controls are configured separately.
